concepts.definition: The employer name as stated by the employer reporting unit in its WGEA Gender Equality Reporting submission for the reporting year. This is the reporting label, not a verified legal name or trading name, and is not a unique identifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.legal_name and entity.trading_name are owned by business and assert a legal/trading status this source does not establish; the value here is a reporting-unit label for a WGEA submission, so owner and meaning differ.

concepts.definition: The ABN the employer reporting unit used to identify itself in its WGEA Gender Equality Reporting submission. It is a reporting identifier for the reporting unit and does not by itself establish legal form or company-wide scope.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.abn is owned by business and asserts the ABN of the business legal person; here the ABN is the reporting unit's submission identifier, so owner and scope differ even though the value format is the same.

concepts.definition: The sector classification the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, distinguishing private from public sector employers. It is a reporting classification, not a legal form.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a source-stated activity/beneficiary tag requiring a scheme qualifier and is owned by business; this is a WGEA private/public sector classification of the reporting unit, so meaning and owner differ.

concepts.definition: The employer size range band reported for the WGEA submission, expressed as an employee-count band such as '<250' or '250-499'. It is a band, not an exact headcount.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents an employer headcount band; ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue band under a named scheme and is not an employee-count band, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC division name the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, e.g. 'Transport, Postal and Warehousing'. It is the publisher's division label, not a coded ANZSIC value.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code and entity.industry_code expect a coded ANZSIC value (division letter, subdivision, group or class) and are owned by business; this column holds a division name label for the reporting unit, so type, meaning and owner differ.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC class name the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, e.g. 'Computer System Design and Related Services'. It is the publisher's class label, not a coded ANZSIC class number.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code and entity.industry_code expect a coded ANZSIC value and are owned by business; this column holds a class name label for the reporting unit, so type, meaning and owner differ.
